verdict.rationale: The delegated-credential portion is richly documented. There are card enrollment and tokenization APIs (POST /acp/v1/tokens), a passkey-authenticated purchase-intent mandate (POST /acp/v1/instructions) and merchant/amount-scoped credential retrieval (POST /acp/v1/instructions/{id}/credentials). TAP signs the agent's checkout interaction with the merchant. However, Visa does not provide a checkout-session object itself, order confirmation rests on a single thin claim ('Confirm payment outcomes and trigger post-purchase actions'), and the product carries an explicit 'in the process of development and deployment' caveat. Missing for 10: a first-party checkout-session API, a documented order-confirmation/payment-outcome API, production availability beyond sandbox, and hands-on or independent evidence of a completed end-to-end agent purchase.
